WELCOME TO BIR LACHIT BORPHUKAN COLLEGE
Welcome to Bir lachit Borphukan
                    College, Sivasagar for co-education .You have just embarked on a journey of discovery and
                    self–revelation that is as much about you as it is about the larger world you inhabit. The college
                    with its infrastructure and facilities is at your disposal to help you grow and develop , and which
                    would surely enable you to become independent citizen of India who can take on the world on your
                    terms.

Dr. Pankaj Jyoti Hazarika
M.A., M.Phil., Ph.D.
I am delighted to welcome you to Bir Lachit Borphukan
                    College website. I hope to convey the passion and enthusiasm that both staff and students bring to
                    you, and all that they do here, making Bir Lachit Borphukan College a wonderful place to learn...

Our Mission
To impart basic higher education programmes and skill
                    oriented programmes to slow learners and students from rural areas and cultivate their talents in
                    all possible way.
Our Vision
Upliftment of slow learners and students from rural
                    areas through basic and quality education, and thereby making them self-reliant.
